subject: chargeback fee even after winning
body: Hi, this is Zenith Fitness Equipment. We just won a dispute we'd been fighting (case disp_14_01) and got the transaction amount back in the payout, but there's still a 500 rupee chargeback fee sitting in the same batch that wasn't reversed. If we won the case shouldn't that fee come back to us too? Please advise.
identity_note: merchant_id field submitted with this ticket (merchant_9) does not match the business name and case reference in the body, which belong to merchant_14.
